// Offline AST source extraction only. Does not import or execute Loki.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/constant"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

type obj map[string]any
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}
type value struct {
	Kind      string            `json:"kind"`
	Name      string            `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Literal   any               `json:"literal,omitempty"`
	Items     []*value          `json:"arguments_or_items,omitempty"`
	Fields    map[string]*value `json:"fields,omitempty"`
	Receiver  *value            `json:"receiver,omitempty"`
	Origin    obj               `json:"origin,omitempty"`
	Execution int               `json:"execution_sequence,omitempty"`
	Path      string            `json:"channel,omitempty"`
}
type env map[string]*value
type runner struct {
	s                 *source
	function, subtest string
	index             []int
	executions        []obj
	wrappers          []obj
	all               []obj
	snapshots         []obj
	assertions        []obj
	rows              []obj
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func hash(b []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) }
func load(root, path, want string) *source {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
	must(err)
	if hash(b) != want {
		panic("source differs from pinned revision: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, b, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return &source{path, b, fs, f}
}
func (s *source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s *source) record(n ast.Node) obj {
	a, b := s.fs.Position(n.Pos()), s.fs.Position(n.End())
	text := s.code(n)
	return obj{"source": s.path, "original_go": text, "sha256": hash([]byte(text)), "source_range": obj{
		"start_byte": a.Offset, "end_byte_exclusive": b.Offset, "start_line": a.Line, "start_column": a.Column, "end_line": b.Line, "end_column": b.Column}}
}
func (s *source) selection(n ast.Node, name string) obj {
	r := s.record(n)
	r["name"] = name
	// Unlike AST ranges, full selections include the original trailing newline.
	end := s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset
	if end >= len(s.data) || s.data[end] != '\n' {
		panic("missing trailing newline")
	}
	r["original_go"] = s.code(n) + "\n"
	r["sha256"] = hash([]byte(s.code(n) + "\n"))
	r["selection_includes_trailing_newline"] = true
	if f, ok := n.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && f.Doc != nil {
		r["documentation"] = s.record(f.Doc)
	}
	if d, ok := n.(*ast.GenDecl); ok && d.Doc != nil {
		r["documentation"] = s.record(d.Doc)
	}
	return r
}
func clone(e env) env {
	out := env{}
	for k, v := range e {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
}
func lit(v any) *value { return &value{Kind: "literal", Literal: v} }
func str(v *value) string {
	if v == nil || v.Kind != "literal" {
		panic("expected source string literal")
	}
	s, ok := v.Literal.(string)
	if !ok {
		panic("expected string")
	}
	return s
}
func list(v *value) []*value {
	if v.Kind == "nil" {
		return []*value{}
	}
	if v.Kind != "array" {
		panic("expected literal array")
	}
	return v.Items
}
func simple(v *value) any {
	if v == nil {
		return nil
	}
	switch v.Kind {
	case "literal", "labels":
		return v.Literal
	case "nil":
		return nil
	case "array":
		out := []any{}
		for _, x := range v.Items {
			out = append(out, simple(x))
		}
		return out
	}
	return nil
}
func pairs(v *value) any {
	if v != nil && v.Kind == "labels" {
		return v.Literal
	}
	return nil
}
func sourcePairs(args []*value) *value {
	if len(args)%2 != 0 {
		panic("odd literal label pairs")
	}
	out := []obj{}
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i += 2 {
		out = append(out, obj{"name": str(args[i]), "value": str(args[i+1])})
	}
	return &value{Kind: "labels", Literal: out}
}
func appendPairs(base, extra *value) *value {
	if base.Kind != "labels" || extra.Kind != "labels" {
		panic("nonliteral source label assignment")
	}
	out := append([]obj{}, base.Literal.([]obj)...)
	for _, p := range extra.Literal.([]obj) {
		found := false
		for i, q := range out {
			if p["name"] == q["name"] {
				out[i] = p
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			out = append(out, p)
		}
	}
	return &value{Kind: "labels", Literal: out}
}
func (r *runner) eval(e ast.Expr, en env) *value {
	if e == nil {
		return &value{Kind: "nil"}
	}
	origin := r.s.record(e)
	switch x := e.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		if x.Kind == token.STRING {
			v, err := strconv.Unquote(x.Value)
			must(err)
			return lit(v)
		}
		if x.Kind == token.INT || x.Kind == token.FLOAT {
			v := constant.MakeFromLiteral(x.Value, x.Kind, 0)
			f, _ := constant.Float64Val(constant.ToFloat(v))
			return lit(f)
		}
		panic("unsupported literal")
	case *ast.Ident:
		if v, ok := en[x.Name]; ok {
			return v
		}
		switch x.Name {
		case "true":
			return lit(true)
		case "false":
			return lit(false)
		case "nil":
			return &value{Kind: "nil"}
		}
		return &value{Kind: "symbolic_identifier", Name: x.Name, Origin: origin}
	case *ast.ParenExpr:
		return r.eval(x.X, en)
	case *ast.SelectorExpr:
		name := r.s.code(x)
		if name == "logqlmodel.ErrorLabel" {
			return lit("__error__")
		}
		if name == "logqlmodel.ErrorDetailsLabel" {
			return lit("__error_details__")
		}
		v := r.eval(x.X, en)
		if v.Kind == "struct" {
			if f, ok := v.Fields[x.Sel.Name]; ok {
				return f
			}
			switch x.Sel.Name {
			case "line", "logLine":
				return lit("")
			case "want", "sample":
				return &value{Kind: "literal", Literal: 0.0, Origin: origin, Name: "Go omitted float64 field zero"}
			case "structuredMetadata":
				return sourcePairs(nil)
			}
			return &value{Kind: "zero_field", Name: x.Sel.Name}
		}
		if v.Kind == "sample" {
			return &value{Kind: "sample_channel", Execution: v.Execution, Path: x.Sel.Name}
		}
		return &value{Kind: "selector", Name: x.Sel.Name, Receiver: v, Origin: origin}
	case *ast.CompositeLit:
		v := &value{Kind: "struct", Fields: map[string]*value{}, Origin: origin}
		if x.Type != nil {
			v.Name = r.s.code(x.Type)
		}
		_, array := x.Type.(*ast.ArrayType)
		if array || v.Name == "Stages" {
			v.Kind = "array"
			v.Items = []*value{}
			v.Fields = nil
		}
		for _, el := range x.Elts {
			if kv, ok := el.(*ast.KeyValueExpr); ok {
				v.Fields[r.s.code(kv.Key)] = r.eval(kv.Value, en)
			} else {
				v.Items = append(v.Items, r.eval(el, en))
			}
		}
		// The deletion-wrapper table uses positional, not keyed, struct literals.
		if v.Kind == "struct" && len(v.Items) == 6 && v.Name == "" {
			for i, n := range []string{"name", "ts", "line", "labels", "structuredMetadata", "ok"} {
				v.Fields[n] = v.Items[i]
			}
		}
		return v
	case *ast.CallExpr:
		args := []*value{}
		for _, a := range x.Args {
			args = append(args, r.eval(a, en))
		}
		name := r.s.code(x.Fun)
		if name == "labels.FromStrings" {
			return sourcePairs(args)
		}
		if name == "labels.EmptyLabels" {
			return sourcePairs(nil)
		}
		if name == "appendLabels" {
			return appendPairs(args[0], args[1])
		}
		if name == "appendLabel" {
			return appendPairs(args[0], sourcePairs(args[1:]))
		}
		if name == "[]byte" || name == "int64" {
			if len(args) != 1 {
				panic("conversion arity")
			}
			return args[0]
		}
		v := &value{Kind: "symbolic_call", Name: name, Items: args, Origin: origin}
		if sel, ok := x.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok {
			v.Name = sel.Sel.Name
			v.Receiver = r.eval(sel.X, en)
			if sel.Sel.Name == "Seconds" && r.s.code(sel.X) == "(20 * time.Millisecond)" {
				return &value{Kind: "literal", Literal: 0.020, Origin: origin, Name: "primitive 20 milliseconds / 1000; not extractor execution"}
			}
		}
		return v
	case *ast.BinaryExpr:
		a, b := r.eval(x.X, en), r.eval(x.Y, en)
		if x.Op == token.MUL && a.Kind == "literal" && b.Kind == "literal" {
			af, aok := a.Literal.(float64)
			bf, bok := b.Literal.(float64)
			if aok && bok {
				return &value{Kind: "literal", Literal: af * bf, Origin: origin, Name: "primitive source multiplication"}
			}
		}
		return &value{Kind: "symbolic_binary", Name: x.Op.String(), Items: []*value{a, b}, Origin: origin}
	case *ast.UnaryExpr:
		v := r.eval(x.X, en)
		if x.Op == token.NOT {
			if v.Kind == "ok" {
				return &value{Kind: "negated_ok", Execution: v.Execution}
			}
			if b, ok := r.boolean(v); ok {
				return lit(!b)
			}
		}
		return &value{Kind: "symbolic_unary", Name: x.Op.String(), Items: []*value{v}, Origin: origin}
	case *ast.FuncLit:
		return &value{Kind: "symbolic_function", Origin: origin}
	case *ast.ArrayType:
		return &value{Kind: "symbolic_type", Origin: origin}
	default:
		return &value{Kind: "symbolic_unresolved", Name: fmt.Sprintf("%T", e), Origin: origin}
	}
}
func (r *runner) boolean(v *value) (bool, bool) {
	if v.Kind == "literal" {
		b, ok := v.Literal.(bool)
		return b, ok
	}
	if v.Kind == "ok" || v.Kind == "negated_ok" {
		b, ok := r.all[v.Execution]["expected_ok"].(bool)
		if v.Kind == "negated_ok" {
			b = !b
		}
		return b, ok
	}
	return false, false
}

// A normalized constructor tree is a source expression, not an executed stage.
// Arguments remain positional, in the original Go constructor's signature order.
func normalized(v *value) any {
	if v == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if v.Kind == "literal" || v.Kind == "labels" {
		return v.Literal
	}
	if v.Kind == "nil" {
		return nil
	}
	if v.Kind == "array" {
		out := []any{}
		for _, a := range v.Items {
			out = append(out, normalized(a))
		}
		return out
	}
	if v.Kind == "symbolic_call" {
		args := []any{}
		for _, a := range v.Items {
			args = append(args, normalized(a))
		}
		out := obj{"constructor": v.Name, "arguments": args, "original": v.Origin}
		if v.Receiver != nil {
			out["receiver"] = normalized(v.Receiver)
		}
		return out
	}
	return v
}
func stages(v *value) []any {
	if v == nil || v.Kind == "nil" || v.Kind == "zero_field" {
		return []any{}
	}
	if v.Kind == "array" {
		return normalized(v).([]any)
	}
	return []any{normalized(v)}
}
func extractor(v *value) obj {
	if v == nil {
		return obj{"constructor": "symbolic_unknown"}
	}
	if v.Name == "mustSampleExtractor" {
		return extractor(v.Items[0])
	}
	if v.Name == "ForStream" {
		return extractor(v.Receiver)
	}
	n := v.Name
	a := v.Items
	out := obj{"constructor": n, "original": v, "conversion": nil, "label": nil, "groups": nil, "without": nil, "no_labels": nil, "stages": []any{}, "post_filter": nil}
	switch n {
	case "LabelExtractorWithStages":
		if len(a) != 7 {
			panic("label extractor arity")
		}
		out["label"] = simple(a[0])
		out["conversion"] = a[1].Name
		out["groups"] = simple(a[2])
		out["without"] = simple(a[3])
		out["no_labels"] = simple(a[4])
		out["stages"] = stages(a[5])
		out["post_filter"] = normalized(a[6])
	case "NewLineSampleExtractor":
		if len(a) != 5 {
			panic("line extractor arity")
		}
		out["conversion"] = a[0].Name
		out["stages"] = stages(a[1])
		out["groups"] = simple(a[2])
		out["without"] = simple(a[3])
		out["no_labels"] = simple(a[4])
	case "NewDistinctValueSampleExtractor":
		if len(a) != 5 {
			panic("distinct extractor arity")
		}
		out["label"] = simple(a[0])
		out["stages"] = stages(a[1])
		out["groups"] = simple(a[2])
		out["without"] = simple(a[3])
		out["no_labels"] = simple(a[4])
		out["value_contract"] = "symbolic xxhash bits, not numeric cardinality"
	case "builderExtractor":
		out["groups"] = simple(a[0])
		out["conversion"] = "CountExtractor"
		out["contract"] = "symbolic original local builder-path function, not executed"
	}
	return out
}
func (r *runner) process(c *ast.CallExpr, en env) (*value, *value) {
	sel := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	receiver := r.eval(sel.X, en)
	args := []*value{}
	for _, a := range c.Args {
		args = append(args, r.eval(a, en))
	}
	if len(args) != 3 {
		panic("process arity")
	}
	var stream *value
	if receiver.Name == "ForStream" {
		stream = receiver.Items[0]
	} else if receiver.Name == "builderExtractor" {
		stream = receiver.Items[1]
	}
	if pairs(stream) == nil {
		panic("Process stream labels unresolved: " + r.s.code(c))
	}
	line := str(args[1])
	md := pairs(args[2])
	if md == nil {
		panic("unresolved metadata")
	}
	sequence := len(r.all)
	e := obj{"execution_id": fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", r.function, sequence), "source_function": r.function, "name": r.subtest, "source_index": append([]int{}, r.index...), "sequence": sequence,
		"method": sel.Sel.Name, "source": r.s.record(c), "timestamp": simple(args[0]), "timestamp_expression": r.s.record(c.Args[0]), "stream_labels": pairs(stream), "structured_metadata": md, "line_bytes_base64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(line)),
		"extractor": extractor(receiver), "expected_ok": nil, "expected_value": nil, "expected_labels": nil, "asserted_channels": []string{}, "assertions": []obj{}, "symbolic_contracts": []obj{}}
	if t, ok := en["tt"]; ok && t.Fields != nil {
		if w, yes := t.Fields["wantOk"]; yes {
			e["expected_ok"] = simple(w)
		}
	}
	if l, ok := en["line"]; ok && l.Fields != nil {
		if skip, yes := l.Fields["skip"]; yes {
			e["expected_ok"] = !simple(skip).(bool)
		}
	}
	if r.function == "TestFilteringSampleExtractor" {
		e["contract"] = "symbolic_deletion_wrapper_not_public_query"
		r.wrappers = append(r.wrappers, e)
	} else {
		r.executions = append(r.executions, e)
	}
	r.all = append(r.all, e)
	return &value{Kind: "sample", Execution: sequence}, &value{Kind: "ok", Execution: sequence}
}
func channel(v *value) (int, string, bool) {
	if v.Kind == "sample" {
		return v.Execution, "sample", true
	}
	if v.Kind == "negated_ok" {
		return v.Execution, "skipped", true
	}
	if v.Kind == "sample_channel" {
		return v.Execution, v.Path, true
	}
	if v.Kind == "ok" {
		return v.Execution, "ok", true
	}
	if v.Kind == "symbolic_call" && v.Receiver != nil {
		if i, p, ok := channel(v.Receiver); ok {
			return i, p + "." + v.Name, true
		}
	}
	return 0, "", false
}
func addChannel(e obj, c string) {
	a := e["asserted_channels"].([]string)
	for _, v := range a {
		if v == c {
			return
		}
	}
	e["asserted_channels"] = append(a, c)
}
func (r *runner) assertion(c *ast.CallExpr, en env) {
	name := r.s.code(c.Fun)
	rec := r.s.record(c)
	r.assertions = append(r.assertions, rec)
	a := []*value{}
	for _, e := range c.Args {
		a = append(a, r.eval(e, en))
	}
	if name == "assertLabelResult" {
		if i, p, ok := channel(a[2]); ok && p == "Labels" {
			e := r.all[i]
			e["expected_labels"] = pairs(a[1])
			addChannel(e, "labels")
			addChannel(e, "hash_symbolic")
			addChannel(e, "string_symbolic")
			e["assertions"] = append(e["assertions"].([]obj), rec)
			e["symbolic_contracts"] = append(e["symbolic_contracts"].([]obj), obj{"contract": "assertLabelResult labels.StableHash and String", "expected_literal_assignment": a[1], "source": rec})
		}
		return
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(name, ".True") || strings.HasSuffix(name, ".False") {
		if i, p, ok := channel(a[1]); ok && p == "ok" {
			e := r.all[i]
			e["expected_ok"] = strings.HasSuffix(name, ".True")
			addChannel(e, "ok")
			e["assertions"] = append(e["assertions"].([]obj), rec)
		}
		return
	}
	if strings.HasSuffix(name, ".Empty") {
		if i, p, ok := channel(a[1]); ok && p == "Labels.Labels" {
			e := r.all[i]
			e["expected_labels"] = []obj{}
			addChannel(e, "labels")
			e["assertions"] = append(e["assertions"].([]obj), rec)
		}
		return
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".Equal") || len(a) < 3 {
		return
	}
	if i, p, ok := channel(a[2]); ok {
		e := r.all[i]
		e["assertions"] = append(e["assertions"].([]obj), rec)
		switch p {
		case "sample":
			if a[1].Kind != "struct" || a[1].Name != "ExtractedSample" || len(a[1].Fields) != 0 {
				panic("unknown whole-sample expectation")
			}
			e["expected_value"] = 0.0
			e["expected_labels_result_is_nil"] = true
			addChannel(e, "value")
			addChannel(e, "labels_nil")
		case "skipped":
			b, ok := simple(a[1]).(bool)
			if !ok {
				panic("nonliteral skipped expectation")
			}
			e["expected_ok"] = !b
			addChannel(e, "ok")
		case "ok":
			e["expected_ok"] = simple(a[1])
			addChannel(e, "ok")
		case "Value":
			if a[1].Kind == "literal" {
				e["expected_value"] = simple(a[1])
				addChannel(e, "value")
			} else {
				e["symbolic_contracts"] = append(e["symbolic_contracts"].([]obj), obj{"source": rec, "expected": a[1], "actual": a[2]})
			}
		case "Labels.Labels":
			e["expected_labels"] = pairs(a[1])
			addChannel(e, "labels")
		default:
			e["symbolic_contracts"] = append(e["symbolic_contracts"].([]obj), obj{"source": rec, "expected": a[1], "actual": a[2]})
		}
	} else {
		// Distinct values are asserted only through Float64bits. Preserve, never evaluate.
		for _, v := range a[2:] {
			if v.Kind == "symbolic_call" {
				for _, arg := range v.Items {
					if i, _, ok := channel(arg); ok {
						e := r.all[i]
						addChannel(e, "value_hash_bits_symbolic")
						e["symbolic_contracts"] = append(e["symbolic_contracts"].([]obj), obj{"contract": "distinct_value_hash_bits", "source": rec, "expected": a[1], "actual": v})
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
func (r *runner) assign(lhs []ast.Expr, rhs []ast.Expr, en env, n ast.Node) {
	if len(rhs) == 1 {
		if c, ok := rhs[0].(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			if sel, yes := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); yes && (sel.Sel.Name == "Process" || sel.Sel.Name == "ProcessString") {
				a, b := r.process(c, en)
				if len(lhs) != 2 {
					panic("Process return arity")
				}
				en[r.s.code(lhs[0])] = a
				en[r.s.code(lhs[1])] = b
				return
			}
		}
	}
	values := []*value{}
	for _, e := range rhs {
		values = append(values, r.eval(e, en))
	}
	for i, l := range lhs {
		if i < len(values) {
			en[r.s.code(l)] = values[i]
		} else {
			en[r.s.code(l)] = &value{Kind: "symbolic_secondary_return"}
		}
	}
	r.snapshots = append(r.snapshots, obj{"source_function": r.function, "name": r.subtest, "source_index": append([]int{}, r.index...), "source": r.s.record(n), "assigned_values": values})
}
func (r *runner) rowRecord(row *value) obj {
	out := obj{"source_function": r.function, "source_index": append([]int{}, r.index...), "row": row, "source": row.Origin}
	for n, v := range row.Fields {
		out[n] = normalized(v)
	}
	if ex, ok := row.Fields["ex"]; ok {
		out["extractor"] = extractor(ex)
	}
	if ex, ok := row.Fields["extractor"]; ok {
		out["extractor"] = extractor(ex)
	}
	if r.function == "TestStages_KeepsErroredLines" {
		out["stages"] = stages(row.Fields["stages"])
		out["post_filters"] = stages(row.Fields["postFilters"])
		delete(out, "postFilters")
	}
	return out
}
func (r *runner) block(b *ast.BlockStmt, en env) bool {
	for _, st := range b.List {
		switch x := st.(type) {
		case *ast.AssignStmt:
			r.assign(x.Lhs, x.Rhs, en, x)
		case *ast.DeclStmt:
			if d, ok := x.Decl.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
				for _, sp := range d.Specs {
					if v, yes := sp.(*ast.ValueSpec); yes {
						lhs := []ast.Expr{}
						for _, n := range v.Names {
							lhs = append(lhs, n)
						}
						r.assign(lhs, v.Values, en, v)
					}
				}
			}
		case *ast.ExprStmt:
			c, ok := x.X.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if !ok {
				panic("unexpected expression statement")
			}
			name := r.s.code(c.Fun)
			if name == "t.Run" {
				fn := c.Args[1].(*ast.FuncLit)
				old := r.subtest
				r.subtest = str(r.eval(c.Args[0], en))
				r.block(fn.Body, clone(en))
				r.subtest = old
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(name, "require.") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "assert.") || name == "assertLabelResult" {
				r.assertion(c, en)
			}
		case *ast.RangeStmt:
			v := r.eval(x.X, en)
			for i, row := range list(v) {
				child := clone(en)
				if x.Key != nil {
					child[r.s.code(x.Key)] = lit(float64(i))
				}
				if x.Value != nil {
					child[r.s.code(x.Value)] = row
				}
				old := r.index
				r.index = append(append([]int{}, old...), i)
				if row.Kind == "struct" {
					r.rows = append(r.rows, r.rowRecord(row))
				}
				r.block(x.Body, child)
				r.index = old
			}
		case *ast.ForStmt:
			// The sole selected integer loop is explicitly i := 0; i < 3; i++.
			if r.s.code(x.Init) != "i := 0" || r.s.code(x.Cond) != "i < 3" || r.s.code(x.Post) != "i++" {
				panic("unknown loop")
			}
			for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
				child := clone(en)
				child["i"] = lit(float64(i))
				old := r.index
				r.index = append(append([]int{}, old...), i)
				r.block(x.Body, child)
				r.index = old
			}
		case *ast.IfStmt:
			v := r.eval(x.Cond, en)
			if yes, known := r.boolean(v); known {
				if yes {
					if r.block(x.Body, en) {
						return true
					}
				} else if x.Else != nil {
					if eb, ok := x.Else.(*ast.BlockStmt); ok {
						r.block(eb, en)
					}
				}
			} else {
				// Hints-only table executor has a nil check and append. Preserve it symbolically;
				// no Process calls or primitive oracles may depend on unknown control flow.
				if strings.Contains(r.s.code(x), ".Process(") || strings.Contains(r.s.code(x), ".ProcessString(") {
					panic("unresolved Process branch")
				}
				r.block(x.Body, clone(en))
			}
		case *ast.BranchStmt:
			if x.Tok == token.CONTINUE {
				return true
			}
			panic("unsupported branch")
		default:
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("unhandled statement %T", st))
		}
	}
	return false
}
func inventory(s *source, f *ast.FuncDecl) obj {
	assertions, process, constructors, controls := []obj{}, []obj{}, []obj{}, []obj{}
	ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			name := s.code(c.Fun)
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "require.") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "assert.") || name == "assertLabelResult" {
				assertions = append(assertions, s.record(c))
			}
			if sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && (sel.Sel.Name == "Process" || sel.Sel.Name == "ProcessString") {
				process = append(process, s.record(c))
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "New") || name == "LabelExtractorWithStages" || name == "builderExtractor" {
				constructors = append(constructors, s.record(c))
			}
		}
		switch n.(type) {
		case *ast.IfStmt, *ast.ForStmt, *ast.RangeStmt, *ast.BranchStmt:
			controls = append(controls, s.record(n))
		}
		return true
	})
	return obj{"source_function": f.Name.Name, "selection": s.selection(f, f.Name.Name), "assertion_calls": assertions, "process_call_sites": process, "constructors": constructors, "control_flow": controls}
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	root := os.Args[1]
	sources := []*source{
		load(root, "pkg/logql/log/metrics_extraction_test.go", "21317d2e294e6bbed25160a1b7cc2486dc106fda5c481b7ab7e915b06ec6b16d"),
		load(root, "pkg/logql/log/pipeline_test.go", "d077ffbf7c67db32416395fb910dbc0440b75e08360ccace3319bfe821888bc2"),
		load(root, "pkg/logql/log/labels_test.go", "5a3383cd2799117f8f96d1e39f5af42d92f2e07a7e205086bff4d4acaa77eff9"),
		load(root, "pkg/logqlmodel/error.go", "21816c4294243f16157f6408d92fb0907612a3258333288ab39b3f84bf7a4db5"),
		load(root, "pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go", "346b91ced2d38e51d8cf7fd8acb3335ea5796e9286fd901b45dd625c0b3634ff"),
	}
	r := &runner{s: sources[0], executions: []obj{}, wrappers: []obj{}, all: []obj{}, rows: []obj{}, snapshots: []obj{}, assertions: []obj{}}
	tests, support, files := []obj{}, []obj{}, []obj{}
	for i, s := range sources {
		files = append(files, obj{"source": s.path, "sha256": hash(s.data), "bytes": len(s.data)})
		for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
			if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok {
				if i == 0 && strings.HasPrefix(f.Name.Name, "Test") {
					tests = append(tests, inventory(s, f))
					r.function = f.Name.Name
					r.subtest = f.Name.Name
					r.block(f.Body, env{})
					continue
				}
				keep := i == 0 && !strings.HasPrefix(f.Name.Name, "Benchmark") || i == 1 && (f.Name.Name == "appendLabels" || f.Name.Name == "newPipelineFilter" || f.Name.Name == "mustFilter") || i == 2 && f.Name.Name == "assertLabelResult" || i == 4 && f.Name.Name == "mustStage"
				if keep {
					name := f.Name.Name
					if f.Recv != nil {
						name = s.code(f.Recv.List[0].Type) + "." + name
					}
					support = append(support, s.selection(f, name))
				}
			} else if i == 0 {
				support = append(support, s.selection(d, "stub types and source imports"))
			}
			if i == 3 {
				if gd, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
					for _, sp := range gd.Specs {
						if v, ok := sp.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok && len(v.Names) == 1 && (v.Names[0].Name == "ErrorLabel" || v.Names[0].Name == "ErrorDetailsLabel") {
							support = append(support, s.record(v))
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(tests) != 16 {
		panic("Test inventory changed")
	}
	for _, t := range tests {
		rows, executions := []obj{}, []string{}
		for _, row := range r.rows {
			if row["source_function"] == t["source_function"] {
				rows = append(rows, row)
			}
		}
		for _, e := range r.all {
			if e["source_function"] == t["source_function"] {
				executions = append(executions, e["execution_id"].(string))
			}
		}
		t["rows"], t["execution_ids"] = rows, executions
	}
	for _, e := range r.all {
		if e["expected_ok"] != nil {
			addChannel(e, "ok")
		}
		if e["expected_value"] != nil && len(e["assertions"].([]obj)) == 0 {
			panic("value without original assertion")
		}
	}
	out := obj{"schema_version": 1, "repository": "https://github.com/grafana/loki", "revision": revision, "contract": "source extraction; no executed constructors or replacement oracles", "sources": files, "tests": tests, "supporting_declarations": support, "literal_rows": r.rows, "assignment_snapshots": r.snapshots, "executions": r.executions, "deletion_wrapper_executions": r.wrappers, "expanded_assertions": r.assertions,
		"test_count": len(tests), "execution_count": len(r.executions), "deletion_wrapper_execution_count": len(r.wrappers), "literal_row_count": len(r.rows)}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(enc.Encode(out))
}
